ryancbuckley opened PR #15199 from ryancbuckley:interp-fcvt-i128 to bytecodealliance:main:

This PR:

  1. Fixes float-to-i128 conversion in the interpreter, so that values not representable in i128 are handled correctly instead of saturating at i128.
  2. Makes some pedantic tweaks to the documentation on fcvt_to_sint and fcvt_to_uint to better reflect the behavior with the fix.
  3. Adds lots of tests for edge cases in float-to-int conversions. These are only tangentially related to the above, so I'd be happy to move them to a separate PR if you'd prefer this PR stay focused on the fix.

Fixes #15198.
